name: viewer-code
title: Code viewers
description: The SVG and CSV kinds: `svgKind` (a preview from a blob URL, or its source) and `csvKind` (a table, with an « @ » action on each row where the shell offers one: `RowReferenceContext`), drawn inside the artifact panel's bar. Each view loads the first time its artifact opens; other code stays in the panel's code block.
